status: Research proposal only; no training, implementation, OCR, local PDF downloads or grant changes.

search.name: Diagnostyka niedomkniecia latentu jako sterowanie doborem danych i active learning
search.read_scope: Summary and first 15 abstracts/metadata; not 161 full-text reads and not necessarily 161 unique studies.

full_text_reader.scope: Targeted questions about acquisition, annotation costs, observability, memory and experimental controls. Notes below are short critical summaries; no verbatim full-text excerpts.

local_sources: ../evidence_grant_2026-09-11/zrodla_lokalne.json; additional targeted read of D59 and E-AQ, plus reviewer map and documents 23-24.

papers.title: Active Learning of Dynamics for Data-Driven Control Using Koopman Operators
papers.note: Existing Koopman active learning for robot dynamics and control; no claim of a new generic Koopman-plus-AL idea.

papers.title: EnKode: Active Learning of Unknown Flows With Koopman Operators
papers.scope: Undermind full-text reader plus primary arXiv abstract
papers.note: Sections III-IV describe point-wise flow acquisition using ensemble disagreement; evaluated against uniform sampling and GP approaches. Does not diagnose missing observation/history or buy semantic bounding-box labels. Sampling policy omits travel cost. Reader output is auxiliary, not reproduction.

papers.title: Regression-Based Projection for Learning Mori-Zwanzig Operators
papers.scope: Undermind full-text reader; primary arXiv and SIAM metadata
papers.note: Regression-defined projection and recursive memory learning. Richer current-state regression does not generally remove missing-state effects. Our ridge lag model is only an empirical probe. Do not adopt reader's overgeneralization that every M<D representation is unclosed, or identify MSE improvement with conditional information.

papers.title: Data-Driven Learning for the Mori-Zwanzig Formalism: A Generalization of the Koopman Learning Framework
papers.note: Existing data-driven Markov and memory operators; not evidence for selecting detector annotations.

papers.title: Active operator inference for learning low-dimensional dynamical-system models from noisy data
papers.note: Trajectory sampling to reduce effects of noise in operator inference; do not transfer reported gains to video.

papers.title: Operator Inference of Non-Markovian Terms for Learning Reduced Models from Partially Observed State Trajectories
papers.note: Prior work for history-dependent reduced dynamics; full proof not audited.

papers.title: Mori-Zwanzig latent space Koopman closure for nonlinear autoencoder
papers.scope: Abstract and primary repository journal metadata
papers.note: Published journal version verified; Undermind listed older preprint. Existing latent AE closure, not evidence of active surgical annotation.

papers.title: LRTD: long-range temporal dependency based active learning for surgical workflow recognition
papers.scope: Undermind full-text reader, primary abstract and author code overview
papers.note: Sections 2.3 and 3.1: weak within-clip dependence scores guide queries; last-frame phase label used with preceding context. Distinct from bounding-box detection. Existing temporal AL prevents novelty claim based just on video dependency. Do not adopt reader's equation of predictive loss difference with information gain; finite probes cannot automatically separate noise.

papers.title: Correlation-Aware Active Learning for Surgery Video Segmentation
papers.scope: Current primary CVF abstract and selected method excerpt; full-text reading belongs to earlier audit 22
papers.note: Clustering and uncertainty for surgery video segmentation. Correct preprint is 2311.08811; unrelated draft identifier 2311.08508 rejected before publication of report.

papers.title: Stream-based active learning for surgical AI
papers.scope: Primary full-text HTML: abstract, introduction, related work and beginning of methods
papers.note: Binary annotation questions, VeSSAL, AAE, and retraining between surgeries; not a measured bounding-box labeling protocol.

papers.title: Representative, Informative, and De-Amplifying: Requirements for Robust Bayesian Active Learning under Model Misspecification
papers.scope: Primary proceedings abstract and metadata; no full-text read in this round
papers.note: AISTATS 2026 PMLR 300:3016-3024; correct publication year supersedes Undermind preprint entry. Model misspecification motivates controls against pure uncertainty selection.

papers.title: Experimental Applications of the Koopman Operator in Active Learning for Control
papers.scope: Publisher and author institution metadata, abstract; no full chapter reading
papers.note: Book chapter in The Koopman Operator in Systems and Control. Search surfaced author PDF https://tberrueta.github.io/assets/pdfs/BerruetaKoopman2020.pdf but direct web open returned 404. Not added to download queue.
